XenotypeDef.label: Gold
XenotypeDef.description: Engineered to rule and built without apology. Golds are stronger, quicker, and sharper than anything else walking, with a physiology tuned for command and for the duel. There is no compensating weakness written into them; the architects saw no reason to install one.\n\nWhat limits Gold is arithmetic. They conceive rarely, gestate fully, and are assembled at enormous cost, so there have never been many and there never will be. A caste that could replace its losses freely would not have stayed a caste for long. Scarcity is the design.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Engineered to rule, with no compensating weakness. Superior in body and mind, and deliberately rare - Golds conceive rarely and cost enormously to make.

XenotypeDef.label: Bronzie
XenotypeDef.description: Gold by birth and by every legal measure, and never once allowed to forget the asterisk. Bronzies come from stock the breeding registries marked down: shorter, plainer, khaki where a Gold should gleam, and denied the archite work that makes their cousins nearly unkillable.\n\nNone of which makes one safe to stand in front of. A Bronzie fights like what they are, and the ones who survive being underestimated tend to become the most dangerous people their caste ever produced. The Society has never worked out whether that is a flaw in the breeding or a flaw in the contempt.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Gold of inferior stock - khaki-colored, unaugmented, and looked down on by their own caste. Still fights like a Gold, and costs a fraction as much to make.

XenotypeDef.label: Silver
XenotypeDef.description: Silvers move capital, contracts, and cargo, and they are built for the parts of that work that happen in a room with other people. Quick with a figure and quicker with a counterparty, they hold the accounts that everything else runs on.\n\nThey were never engineered for labor of any kind, and it shows the moment one is asked to lift something.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Financiers and traders, engineered for negotiation and rapid calculation. Physically slight and useless at manual work.

XenotypeDef.label: White
XenotypeDef.description: Whites arbitrate. They hold the rites, read the law, and pronounce on questions the other Colors are not permitted to settle among themselves. Their authority is procedural rather than physical, and it is absolute within its scope.\n\nEngineered for composure and for the long view, a White is difficult to rattle and nearly impossible to hurry. They are also, by construction, no threat to anyone in a room.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Clergy and judges, engineered for composure, rhetoric, and the long view. Serene, persuasive, and physically harmless.

XenotypeDef.label: Copper
XenotypeDef.description: Coppers run the machinery of administration: the filings, the licences, the vast indifferent apparatus through which every other Color's life is processed. They are engineered for retention and for procedure, and they genuinely enjoy both.\n\nA Copper's power is entirely borrowed from the forms they control, which is why they guard them so jealously.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Administrators and lawyers, engineered for memory, procedure, and paperwork. Sharp, sociable, and physically negligible.

XenotypeDef.label: Blue
XenotypeDef.description: Blues are grown for the bridge. Spatial reasoning, reaction time, and a tolerance for confinement that would break most people are all written in, along with a comfort in cold and dark that comes from generations spent nowhere near a planet.\n\nOn a deck they are irreplaceable. On the ground they are visibly out of their element, pale and slightly wrong-footed by open sky.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Pilots and bridge crew, engineered for spatial reasoning and reaction time. Brilliant aboard ship, frail and awkward on the ground.

XenotypeDef.label: Yellow
XenotypeDef.description: Yellows are the Society's physicians and researchers, engineered with the fine motor control and the retentive memory that both trades demand. They are also engineered to be entirely incapable of violence in any useful sense, which is not an oversight - a caste that holds everyone's life in its hands is safer without hands that can take one.\n\nThey are quiet, exact, and famously difficult to hurry.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Doctors and researchers with fine motor control and rapid learning. Precise and studious, and deliberately hopeless in a fight.

XenotypeDef.label: Green
XenotypeDef.description: Greens keep the networks running. They were built to hold enormous structures in their heads and to stay awake doing it, and they tend to regard the physical world as a poorly documented inconvenience.\n\nThe sleep engineering was a productivity measure. Its effect on Green temperament was noted at the time and considered acceptable.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Programmers and technicians, engineered to hold vast structures in mind and to need very little sleep. Brilliant, insular, physically frail.

XenotypeDef.label: Violet
XenotypeDef.description: Violets make the things the higher Colors display to one another. Sculpture, performance, ornament, spectacle - the entire apparatus by which power demonstrates that it is more than force.\n\nThey are engineered for taste and for expressiveness, and they are among the few Colors permitted, quietly, to be strange.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Artisans and performers, engineered for expressiveness and fine craft. Charming and inventive, with no aptitude for hard labor.

XenotypeDef.label: Orange
XenotypeDef.description: Oranges build and maintain everything the Society actually runs on. Reactors, hulls, lifts, weapons - if it has moving parts, an Orange somewhere is keeping it moving, usually without being told and usually without being thanked.\n\nThey are engineered with the hands and the patience for it, and with an unshakeable conviction that they are the only Color doing real work.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Mechanics and engineers with exceptional hands and endless patience for machines. Skilled and practical, poor with people.

XenotypeDef.label: Gray
XenotypeDef.description: Grays are the hand that actually touches the other Colors. Police, garrison, escort, enforcement - the ordinary daily violence of keeping a hierarchy in place, performed by people engineered to perform it without much feeling about it either way.\n\nThey are steady, disciplined, hard to provoke and hard to stop. They are also, as a caste, not happy, and the engineers who built their temperament regarded that as a feature.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Soldiers and police, engineered for marksmanship and cold discipline. Steady and hard to rattle, and constitutionally grim.

XenotypeDef.label: Obsidian
XenotypeDef.description: The largest and most dangerous thing the Society ever grew, and it keeps them at the bottom of its own hierarchy on purpose. Obsidians are enormous, cold-adapted, and engineered to keep moving through injuries that would end anyone else.\n\nEverything that makes them formidable was paired with something that makes them governable. They learn slowly, they were never given the words to argue, and what they were taught about the Colors above them was not taught as history.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Enormous cold-adapted warriors, engineered for lethality and paired with slow learning and few words. Kept at the bottom of the hierarchy deliberately.

XenotypeDef.label: Pink
XenotypeDef.description: Pinks are engineered for company - for reading a room faster than anyone in it, for grace, for the performance of ease. It is genuine skill, and the Society is careful never to call it that.\n\nThey were also built breakable. Slight frames, low pain tolerance, no capacity for a fight worth the name. A caste kept for its presence is not permitted the means to leave.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Social functionaries, engineered for beauty, grace, and reading people. Genuinely skilled, and deliberately built fragile.

XenotypeDef.label: Brown
XenotypeDef.description: Browns cook, clean, carry, and keep house for every Color above them, which is all of them. The work is endless and almost entirely invisible, and it is performed by people engineered to be placid about that.\n\nThey are hardy in the small ways that matter for the job - iron stomachs, even tempers, an unusual tolerance for being ignored.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Servants and cooks, engineered placid and hardy with iron stomachs. Capable in the kitchen and the household, and nowhere else.

XenotypeDef.label: Red
XenotypeDef.description: The base of the pyramid and the largest Color by an enormous margin. Reds cut, haul, and drill in heat and dark that would kill anyone not built for it, and they were built for it - compact frames, tolerance for foul air and high temperature, eyes that work by lamplight.\n\nThey were also engineered to breed early and often, and denied the education that would let them do anything else. The result is a caste that is very good at one thing and has been carefully prevented from discovering it could be good at others.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Miners and laborers, built compact and heat-tolerant with eyes for the dark. Numerous and quick to reproduce, and denied any education.

XenotypeDef.label: Fulgur Bellator
XenotypeDef.description: A Green built to be taken outside. Where the caste is normally grown slight and kept behind a console, these are thickened and toughened deliberately, then attached to a Gray squad and walked into places where the electronics need persuading at close range.\n\nThe work is the same work. The difference is that a Fulgur Bellator is expected to survive doing it, which their cousins in the server halls find both admirable and faintly horrifying.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Combat-hardened Greens, bred thicker and tougher and attached to Gray squads to break enemy electronics in the field.

XenotypeDef.label: Lurcher
XenotypeDef.description: Named for a dog bred to bring down game heavier than itself, and the name is the whole doctrine. Lurchers are Grays given senses the rest of their caste never got - sight and scent sharpened well past baseline - and then trained for one specific quarry.\n\nThe Society is careful about how many it makes. A caste built to kill highColors is a useful thing to own and a dangerous thing to have.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Grays altered for superior sight and scent and trained to kill highColors. Deadly, watchful, and produced in deliberately small numbers.

XenotypeDef.label: Stained
XenotypeDef.description: The strongest of a caste already grown to frighten. Stained are picked out of the Martian tribes and finished properly - bigger, harder, and marked so that everyone can see what they are before they are close enough to matter.\n\nThey are as rare and as expensive as anything the Society trades in, and a highColor who owns one is careful to mention it.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Elite Obsidian warriors, the strongest of their caste. Enormous, near-unstoppable, and as rare and costly as anything the Society trades.

XenotypeDef.label: Ascomanni
XenotypeDef.description: The warlords who ran for the dark after the revolt failed, and everything that has happened to their descendants since. Centuries out past the last useful sunlight, cutting at their own genome with no Board looking over their shoulder, they have drifted a long way from the tribes they left.\n\nWhat came back is bigger, colder, faster to anger, and entirely uninterested in the hierarchy that exiled it. They are spoken of on the ice the way the ice is spoken of everywhere else.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Obsidian exiles from the outer dark, self-modified over centuries beyond Society oversight. Enormous, cold-adapted, and savagely aggressive.

XenotypeDef.label: Rose
XenotypeDef.description: The Gardens produce a great many Pinks and, occasionally, a Rose. The difference is not effort - every Pink is trained past exhaustion - but something in the stock that the trainers can recognise early and the buyers will ruin themselves over.\n\nA Rose reads a room the way a Blue reads a ship. They are priced accordingly, and the pricing is the point: to own one is to be seen owning one.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: The finest Pinks, rare and ruinously expensive. Unmatched at reading and moving a room, and as fragile as the rest of their caste.

XenotypeDef.label: Ultraheavy
XenotypeDef.description: Reds bred for the Rim, where the gravity runs well past twice Earth's and the radiation never stops. They are built dense rather than tall, and they are built to keep working in conditions that would fold anything else the Society makes.\n\nThe engineering does what it was asked to do. It also burns through them quickly, and everyone involved has decided that is an acceptable trade.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Reds bred for the Rim's crushing gravity and radiation. Dense, immensely strong, radiation-hardened, and burned through fast.
